DR-011-R01.title: FACT-PLANE
DR-011-R01.disposition: Product subject-scope/view/fact/Coverage schemas supply the declared view and subject-set joins; native RequirementV2/Coverage3 supply closed unavailable-rung/deficiency and resolution completeness. Workflow D9 maps typed outcomes. The old D9-v1.6 checker is not the current validator.

DR-011-R02.title: FACT-IDENTITY
DR-011-R02.disposition: Existing relation payload and normalization recipes are preserved by exact version; product fact2 wrapper, stable finding-key2, producer/version/semantic context and explicit clone candidate projections supply current authority. Old 13/14 self-census is not elevated. Arbitrary imperative plugins/hostile-code extensions remain outside D-371; no new authority is inferred from their corpus parks.

DR-011-R03.title: C2
DR-011-R03.disposition: Product plan2/exec-plan2 schemas and exact semantic joins are the explicit prospective alternative. New source-pinned reference instruments require independent review. No v4/v5 checker is relabeled accepted due to a newer filename or green self-census.

DR-011-R04.title: DELIVERY
DR-011-R04.disposition: Product native protocol and security lifecycle/core bridge are explicit successors for selected major-two/three fields; their fixtures/schemas/checkers must agree. Historical OBS-1/checker-version skew and old major-one fixtures retain their original standing. Stage delivery must use the current signed profile/closure inventory and qualification matrix.

DR-011-R05.title: Rust PC-7
DR-011-R05.disposition: Product protocol-major-3 and source/fact/Coverage negotiation, exact transaction/EOF/error rules and sealed dependency/prepared inputs prospectively replace the affected merged-major-2 surface. Rejected base-v2 remains rejected; product acceptance is based on the new reviewed unit, not rewritten base history.

DR-011-R06.title: EVIDENCE
DR-011-R06.disposition: Identity-and-evidence is the new Phase-1A owning packet: proof match/no-match/indeterminate/fault/verdict, exact retained verification/regeneration closure, custody, immutable assurance/current availability, expiry/purge/D9 and claim joins. Applied v15 stays applied; its rejected validator is not elevated.

DR-011-R07.title: RETENTION
DR-011-R07.disposition: CD-RT-5 and applied v28 posture are preserved explicitly. The product evidence/retention/D9 contract and reviewed transition/check suite replace the missing result integration. The old unreviewed checker remains unreviewed rather than being accepted by a passing invocation.

DR-011-R08.title: D9
DR-011-R08.disposition: Product command/step termination has a closed host-owned outcome, precise observation-to-faultCause mapping, branch-specific optional fields, cancellation and post-commit required-output exit4. The three checker-derived gaps and R-V114-F1/F2 need explicit retained cases; old v1.14 ordering/goldens remain the inherited baseline where compatible.

DR-011-R09.title: R-1
DR-011-R09.disposition: Product semantic IDs exclude RequestId/ExecutionId, lifetime, credentials, cache state, receipt timestamps and storage paths; retries can share a Run but never reuse attempt authority. Plan binds semantic grant projection and exact inputs. Policy-derivation2 binds Plan/proof/policy/waivers/verdict. Reviewed product reference cases are the explicit alternative to unreviewed check-r1-v1.7 and CIR-B1; historical checker standing stays unchanged.

DR-011-R10.title: blind consumer-B
DR-011-R10.disposition: Must actually run a fresh implementer litmus after the final integrated surface/identity/evidence decisions. A reader must reconstruct the planned lifecycle and canonical identities from the current contracts, exercise independent vectors and identify any needed invention. This row cannot be closed by this proposed table.

DR-011-R11.title: OPERABILITY G19
DR-011-R11.disposition: Product evidence contract defines durable commit, acknowledgements, recovery, retention pins, GC, backup/import and availability/D9; security defines native carrier and concurrency obligations; workflow defines public parity. Reference transitions are design evidence. Real supported-platform fsync/process-death/storage measurements remain explicit release gates, not claimed completed measurements.

DR-011-R12.title: EVALUATION PROOF
DR-011-R12.disposition: The separate v8 claim and v13 provenance lineages are prospectively replaced by product proof/evidence/seal and authenticated trusted evaluator replay. Every 19 RES, seven NB and four measured escapes has an individual disposition in evaluation-residual-dispositions.proposed.json. The product makes no malicious-same-process Python containment claim, and the old candidates/escapes remain historical.

DR-011-R13.title: VERSIONING
DR-011-R13.disposition: Workflow executable detector pivot, portable baseline and typed multi-axis comparison are the owning successor; current D9 and retention are explicit dependencies. RC-14's required capability/compatibility behavior needs retained current cases. Old v14/v15/v16 rejection, misleading checker filename and v17 unreviewed standing remain unchanged.

DR-011-R14.title: CFG-6/TM
DR-011-R14.disposition: Preserve the already restored CFG-6 threat root in TM v3. Do not reopen it because of the stale v2 note. Product sealed inputs, identity/proof/custody, explicit trusted repository-code principal, storage and G19 give the current TM assumptions and implementation obligations; no claim that a stale citation itself was the remaining threat-model defect.

DR-011-R15.title: trusted request context
DR-011-R15.disposition: ProjectId marker/registry/namespace and RequestId/ExecutionId are operationally explicit; current source/Plan/fact/view/proof/Run computations and one-writer custody supply the identity/evidence dependency. Hash equality does not grant permission, prove local custody, or authorize replay of expired grants.

DR-011-R16.title: product authority
DR-011-R16.disposition: D-367 delegation and D-370/D-371 scope are preserved. The first-party bounded component selection does not open an independent third-party catalog/plugin ecosystem; P-1/P-2/G3 implications are explicit in D-372. CD-RT-5 durable-unbounded default remains binding. No checker changes product posture.
